subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should existing paired operator tokens be upgraded to include `operator.questions`, or should answering agent questions require explicit re-pairing or re-approval?
rationale: This is an authorization and upgrade-policy choice: silently changing stored tokens broadens an existing device capability, while not changing them leaves previously paired clients unable to use the new feature.

options.title: Migrate existing eligible pairings
options.body: Add a narrow, tested token/profile upgrade so existing authorized operator devices receive question access and can display a clear recovery path if refresh is required.

options.title: Require explicit re-approval
options.body: Keep stored tokens unchanged but surface an in-product re-pair or approval recovery flow that explains how to enable question access.

recommendation.title: Migrate existing eligible pairings
recommendation.body: Add a narrow, tested token/profile upgrade so existing authorized operator devices receive question access and can display a clear recovery path if refresh is required.
